earnings.title: Cognizant Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: 12% year-over-year revenue growth in Financial Services; strong EPS growth, adjusted operating margin expansion, and free cash flow generation
Revenue of $5.7 billion increased 4.6% year-over-year or 4.8% in constant currency
GAAP EPS 2 of $1.39 increased 148% year-over-year; Adjusted EPS 1 of $1.49 increased 7.2% year-over-year
Operating margin of 15.4% decreased 60 basis points year-over-year; Adjusted Operating Margin 1 of 16.3% increased 30 basis points year-over-year

quotes.text: We delivered third-quarter revenue above the midpoint of our guidance range, including another quarter of double-digit growth in Financial Services and our seventh consecutive quarter of year-over-year adjusted operating margin expansion.
quotes.by: Ravi Kumar S, Chief Executive Officer

quotes.text: Our third-quarter performance reflects the strength of our operating model and disciplined approach to capital allocation.

outlook: 2026 constant currency revenue growth guidance is revised to 4.0% to 4.4% year-over-year growth
2026 Adjusted Operating Margin guidance is now approximately 16.1%, year-over-year expansion of 30 basis points
2026 Adjusted Diluted EPS guidance revised to $5.72 to $5.79, year-over-year growth of 8% to 10%

We now expect to record total costs of $180 million to $250 million, with $140 million to $160 million of costs expected to be incurred in 2026 and the remainder to be incurred through the first quarter of 2027.

items.heading: Our results of operations could be adversely affected by macroeconomic and geopolitical conditions globally and in particular in the markets in which our clients and operations are concentrated.
items.group: Risks Related to our Business and Operations

items.heading: Our use of AI technologies may not be successful and may present business, financial, legal and reputational risks.

If we are unable to attract, train and retain skilled employees to satisfy client demand, including highly skilled technical personnel and personnel with experience in key AI and digital areas, as well as senior management to lead our business globally, our business and results of operations may be materially adversely affected.

Many of our contracts with clients are short-term, and our business, results of operations and financial condition could be adversely affected if our clients terminate their contracts on short notice.

Our failure to meet specified service levels or milestones required by certain of our client contracts may result in our client contracts being less profitable, potential liability for penalties or damages or reputational harm.
We may not be able to achieve our profitability goals and maintain our capital return strategy.
